description: This source file defines the 'GrainContextAccessor' class within the Orleans.Runtime namespace, providing an implementation of the 'IGrainContextAccessor' interface. It manages access to the current grain context, utilizing a hosted client as a fallback.

classes.name: GrainContextAccessor
classes.description: Provides access to the current grain context, falling back to a hosted client if the runtime context is not available.

methods.name: GrainContextAccessor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the accessor with a hosted client.

methods.name: GrainContext
methods.description: Property that returns the current grain context or the hosted client if the current context is null.
